name: files
description: Agent-first file management — index local folders and S3 buckets, sync Google Drive, tag, search, organize, and serve an evidence vault. CLI + MCP + HTTP API (files-serve) + generated SDK. Cloud mode (HASNA_FILES_STORAGE_MODE=cloud) is PURE REMOTE per Amendment A1: the serve process reads/writes the shared cloud Postgres directly with API-key auth via @hasna/contracts; file bytes stay in S3.
